user.title: Eversolo device
user.description: Give the player a name (it becomes the prefix of entity ids, e.g. media_player.eversolo) and enter its IP address. The default API port is 9529. Allow Home Assistant on the device screen when it asks.

authorize.title: Confirm on the device
authorize.description: The device at {host} did not confirm in time. Press Submit, then allow Home Assistant on the Eversolo screen.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check the address and that it is on the same network.
error.not_authorized: The device has not confirmed the connection.

init.title: Eversolo settings
init.description: Change the name, IP address or port. Existing entity ids are kept; rename entities in Settings if you want new ids.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check the address and that it is on the same network.
error.not_authorized: The device has not confirmed the connection.

name.name: Name
name.description: Input name or tag as listed in input_list.

name.name: Name
name.description: Output name or tag as listed in output_list.

set_loop_mode.name: Set loop mode
set_loop_mode.description: Repeat list, repeat track, shuffle or play the list once.

vu_next.name: VU meter: next mode
vu_next.description: Same as the VU button in the Eversolo app.

spectrum_next.name: Spectrum: next mode
spectrum_next.description: Same as the spectrum button in the Eversolo app.

open_app.name: Open streaming app
open_app.description: Open an app installed on the device (see app_list).

power.name: Power menu
power.description: Run an entry of the device power menu (see power_list).

name.name: Name
name.description: Entry name as shown in power_list, or its tag.

request.name: Raw request
request.description: GET any device API path and return the response.
